body.summary: An animated reworking of Scott Pilgrim in which Matthew Patel apparently kills Scott at the first Evil Ex fight, so Ramona Flowers spends the season investigating his disappearance. Her search runs through each ex in turn and through a film production of Scott's 'Precious Little Life' that Young Neil supposedly wrote, before revealing that a time-travelling Older Scott staged the kidnapping to stop the relationship from starting. ||The finale has even-older Scotts attack, Ramona chooses Scott, and the exes reform into running a theater.||

arcs.summary: Scott is apparently killed by Matthew Patel, and Ramona starts investigating.
Matthew Patel topples Gideon and takes the League and empire.
Ramona works through each ex as suspect, clearing Roxie, Lucas, Todd and Gideon.
Young Neil's movie becomes a Broadway musical bankrolled by Patel.
Scott is found in the future; Older Scott admits he staged the kidnapping to stop the romance.
Even-older Scotts attack the theater; ||Ramona chooses Scott and sends the rampaging Scotts home.||

the artist's ownership of their own story

notable_scenes.summary: Matthew Patel crashes Sex Bob-omb's set and Scott vanishes in a portal mid-fight.
At the funeral, Envy Adams performs while the exes receive invitations to the lair.
Matthew Patel fights Gideon for the league and wins everything by signed contract.
Ramona and Roxie fight in the video store, then reconcile.
On Lucas Lee's set, Wallace is cast as himself after heckling, and Lucas fights the paparazzi.
Todd falls for Wallace and gives up veganism; Envy fires Ramona.
Ramona lays out the who, why and how, then learns the script was written 14 years from now.
Older Scott gives the future tour and admits he brought Scott forward on purpose.
Even Older Scott unleashes the Anti-Kiss fields and fights everyone at the musical.
